findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Code injection via eval/exec
 * @description Using eval or exec with untrusted input can lead to arbitrary code execution
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/code-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-094
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("__builtins__").getMember(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall()
select call, "Potentially unsafe code execution operation that could execute arbitrary code."

message.text: Potentially unsafe code execution operation that could execute arbitrary code.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Comprehensive injection vulnerabilities
 * @description Check for various injection vulnerabilities with data flow
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/comprehensive-injection
 * @tags security
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.RemoteFlowSources
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  // Code injection
  call = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember(["eval", "exec", "compile"]).getACall() or
  // Command injection
  call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() or
  call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["system", "popen", "popen2", "popen3", "popen4"]).getACall() or
  // SQL injection (though unlikely in tqdm)
  call = API::moduleImport("sqlite3").getMember(["execute", "executemany"]).getACall() or
  // File path injection
  exists(DataFlow::CallCfgNode fileCall |
    fileCall = API::moduleImport("builtins").getMember("open").getACall() or
    fileCall = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "chmod", "chown", "remove", "unlink", "rename"]).getACall() or
    fileCall = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["copy", "move", "rmtree"]).getACall()
  |
    call = fileCall
  )
select call, "Potential injection sink that could be vulnerable if user input reaches it"
findings.hypothesis: Comprehensive injection vulnerabilities including code, command, SQL, and file path injection

message.text: Potential injection sink that could be vulnerable if user input reaches it
Potential injection sink that could be vulnerable if user input reaches it
